context:
Decision gate (owner): approve this offer before any upstream contact.

Verification rubric: (1) the reduced change applies to current upstream main; (2) its dialect tests pass on the real engine; (3) the fork's downstream contract tests pass after the patches.json edit.

Guardrails: no pull request, issue or comment on tobymao/sqlglot until the owner approves this specific offer in this item's context; the offered change must be the fork patch reduced to upstream-only behaviour; the patch stays carried in patches.json until upstream merges and a refresh retires it with equivalence evidence.

Upstream rules (tobymao/sqlglot AGENTS.md): Conventional Commits title ending with the agent model ([CLAUDE], [CODEX]); minimal scope; tests in tests/dialects that run on the real engine; no fork-only behaviour or benchbox package references.

2026-11-21: prepared but not offered.
